Hi Jonas / Laura —

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal is starting the paperwork and we need to confirm insurance exhibits for the Master Services Agreement and the Order Form. Our procurement team requires:

- COI naming: "BrightPay, Inc., its affiliates and customers" as Additional Insured (CGL)
- Coverage minimums: CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, Cyber 2M (see attached ordering form)
- Endorsement: Additional Insured endorsement on CGL; waiver of subrogation where permitted

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the COI + endorsement prior to signature and whether you can add "customers" as a named party? If that is not an option, please propose an alternative workflow (staging evidence, designation by customer, etc.).

Timing: procurement hopes to complete contract execution by 6/25; please advise if that timeline is feasible.

Attachments: BrightPay_Coverage_Request.pdf

Best,

Emma —

Thanks — looping in Legal (Aditya) and Ops (Laura) to confirm the approach. Quick notes from our side:

- Redwood standard coverage we can provide on a COI: CGL 1,000,000 / 2,000,000 agg; Professional (E&O) 2,000,000; Cyber 2,000,000.
- Additional Insured: we typically add AI for CGL via endorsement; naming "customers" can be broad and may require underwriting approval.
- Waiver of subrogation and primary/noncontributory language: acceptable in many cases, but will need insurer sign-off.

Aditya — could you review the attached ordering form and propose a couple of acceptable exhibit wordings? Also cc'ing our broker if Emma wants to introduce them.

Hi Emma / team —

I've reviewed the ordering form. Attached is a short draft insurance exhibit and a redlined sample COI (Draft_COI_Redwood_v3.pdf) showing how we can deliver evidence. High-level:

1) CGL Additional Insured: we can add "BrightPay, its officers, directors, and affiliates" as Additional Insured via ISO CG 20 10 (or equivalent) endorsement for ongoing operations; naming "customers" is unusually broad and will trigger underwriter review.
2) Limits: the limits you requested are consistent with our carriers; Cyber and E&O proofs may be provided as insurer declarations or redacted policies if required.
3) Waiver of subrogation/primary & noncontributory: generally acceptable but sometimes restricted by policy language — we'll confirm with broker.

If BrightPay needs customers specifically named, please have your procurement provide a short rationale and indicate whether that applies to all orders or a limited set — that will help us take a position with carriers.

Next steps proposed:
- Jonah/Laura: if ops confirms internal acceptance we will request formal binder/endorsement from our broker and aim to issue COI + endorsement within 5 business days of broker request.
- Emma: share broker contact if you want us to coordinate directly.

Attachments: MSA_Insurance_Exhibit_v1.docx; Draft_COI_Redwood_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Contract timeline: we still aim to get to signature by 6/25; if endorsement issuance will push that, we can accept a conditional workflow: COI at signature with full endorsement within 10 business days post-signature. Please confirm if Redwood can accept that sequencing.

Best,

Emma —

Thanks for the quick replies and the broker intro. Proposed sequencing (we can commit to this):

- Before signature: provide a COI showing requested limits (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, Cyber 2M) and a statement that Additional Insured endorsement has been requested for CGL naming "BrightPay, its officers, directors and affiliates".
- At signature: procurement may accept the COI as evidence; endorsement to follow.
- Post-signature (target within 10 business days): issue the AI endorsement on CGL; confirm waiver of subrogation/primary & noncontributory status if carrier allows.

Regarding "customers": we are open to making this work but need BrightPay to confirm whether that must be an explicit universal inclusion or if you can provide a list of customer entities at time of order. If universal naming is required, we will need underwriter sign-off and that may impact timing/costs.

Action items:
- Emma / BrightPay: confirm whether you can accept the conditional sequencing or whether you require "customers" to be named at signature.
- Samir (broker): please liaise with our broker to understand if universal "customers" naming is feasible; copying Aditya and Laura for context.

I'll upload the draft exhibit and COI to the shared Drive folder and can generate a DocuSign order form that notes the conditional acceptance in the signature block.

Attachments: Draft_COI_Redwood_v3.pdf; MSA_Insurance_Exhibit_v1.docx

Best,
